description: The bar chart, labeled as Figure 2, illustrates the accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment and STS tasks. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with six task names: "sentiment analysis", "paraphrase detection", "STS-B", "sentiment (binary)", "paraphrase (binary)", and "STS-B (binary)". The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each category has three bars, colored beige, pink, and blue, representing "Baseline Model", "STS-Con", and "Paraphrase Ans", respectively, as indicated by the legend. The bars are grouped together for each category, with the beige bar being the shortest and the blue and pink bars being taller, with values ranging from approximately 0.6 to 0.85. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
